business_need_date.description: Documented business or control date that the decision must protect.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot, serial set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: Use ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise use LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 because the third option is outside current authority; otherwise use 0.

observed_quantity.description: Observed source quantity before applying the control for outside operation completion.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the independently documented business/control date; positive means late.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: EA.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend or avoidable exposure of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing complete_accepted_quantity, complete_sent_quantity, wait_for_full_return.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying all source constraints.

source_quantity.description: quantity sent to the supplier operation

supported_quantity.description: accepted quantity received and available to the order

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the Oracle mutation may persist.
